proposals.title: Shareholder Proxy Access Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend the proxy access bylaw so shareholders may nominate 20% of directors or 2, whichever is greater, increasing potential board representation.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 4.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to report on the feasibility of integrating sustainability metrics into senior executive performance measures, goals, or vesting conditions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to report annually on Apple's policies on freedom of expression and access to information, oversight mechanisms, and actions taken in response to government demands.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 6.
